healthBenefits.title: Vitamin C Boost
healthBenefits.text: Lemon slices provide antioxidant vitamin C, supporting immune function and skin health.

healthBenefits.title: Cardiovascular Support
healthBenefits.text: Garlic contains allicin, a compound linked to improved heart health and reduced blood pressure.

healthBenefits.title: Healthy Fats
healthBenefits.text: Extra virgin olive oil supplies monounsaturated fats and polyphenols that support heart and anti-inflammatory health.

healthBenefits.title: Prebiotic Fiber
healthBenefits.text: Red onion offers fiber and prebiotics that promote gut health and beneficial bacteria growth.

healthBenefits.title: Sustainable Energy
healthBenefits.text: Stale bread provides complex carbohydrates for steady energy without food waste.

healthBenefits.title: Anti-inflammatory Herbs
healthBenefits.text: Oregano contains antioxidants like carvacrol, which have antimicrobial and anti-inflammatory properties.

_ingredientsText:
½ cup of cold water 
	1 slice of stale bread or toasted bread
	2 slices organic lemon 
	oregano 
	½ small red onion, chopped
	1 clove garlic (optional) 
	1 teaspoon extra virgin olive oil 
	salt
